# FIXIT by Musée Initialize

> FIXIT is an AI-powered health, movement, and rehabilitation platform by Musée Initialize (Toronto, Canada). It turns any device camera into an objective movement-assessment tool: patients follow guided exercise demos, record their reps, and get instant AI form scoring, while practitioners prescribe exercises and monitor progress remotely. Ideal for physiotherapy, rehab, older-adult home exercise, and strength training. Free to start.

## What FIXIT does
- **AI form scoring**: camera-based pose analysis (range of motion, control, consistency) scores each exercise rep — no wearables.
- **Guided exercise library**: 75+ exercises across knee, hip, lower back, neck, shoulder, core, ankle and more, each with a demo video and step-by-step how-to.
- **Remote rehab**: practitioners assign exercises and monitor adherence + scores remotely — built for people (including older adults) who can't repeatedly visit a clinic.
- **Pain & progress tracking**: pain journal, outcome measures, and progress charts.
- **Know Your Injury**: interactive 3D anatomy so patients understand their injury.
